learning_outcomes.text: Write and develop a program in C language using functions: definitions, interests, prototypes.
Write and develop a program in C language using 1 & 2 D arrays: syntax, use, parameters.
Write and develop a program in C language using string functions: manipulating chains of characters.
Write and develop a program in C language using pointers: syntax, manipulation, using them correctly.
Write and develop a program in C language using structures: syntax, manipulation, establishing parameters.
Write and develop a program in C language using binary and text files: manipulation and relation to structures.
Write and develop a program in C language using dynamic allocation.

syllabus_topics: Algorithms, processors, fundamentals, environment and variables
C Language: programming structure, declarations, control structures (if, switch, while, do while, for), entries / exits (printf, scanf, fflush role)
Review of general notions for arrays, functions, character chains, structures, pointers, dynamic allocation, files
degree: Master of Technology - Electronic Embedded Systems (EES)
